name: chronicle
description: Records every Claude Code session's toil into an account-scoped SQLite chronicle — per-turn token usage (input, cache read/creation, output, thinking), context growth, prompts, tool calls, subagents, compactions, duration and API-equivalent cost — via fail-safe SessionStart/Stop/SessionEnd hooks. Backfills from existing transcripts. The overseer dashboard grows a Chronicle page when it is present.
